channel.title: mint - news
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: Rahul Gandhi–Ajmal Kasab comparison row: Congress Seva Dal files cyber complaint against ex-IAF officer
item.description: Congress Seva Dal has filed a cyber complaint against retired IAF Flight Lieutenant Anoop Verma over an X post comparing Rahul Gandhi with 26/11 convict Ajmal Kasab. The organisation said it would pursue the matter through 'appropriate legal channels'.

item.title: EU scrap curbs may raise costs for Indian metalmakers, threaten MSMEs
item.description: A proposed EU rule could restrict metal scrap shipments to India, forcing manufacturers to find alternative supplies and potentially raising raw material and logistics costs.

item.title: Trump tells AI giants to ‘self-police’: What does ‘morally binding’ White House accord mean?
item.description: Donald Trump has backed an AI “self-policing” accord with leading tech companies, rejecting calls for regulatory guardrails. The White House framework calls for internal controls, independent assessments and board oversight, while Trump describes it as “morally binding” but not legally enforceable.

item.title: ‘Sundar is his name’: Donald Trump calls Pichai a ‘monster’; Google CEO has a witty comeback
item.description: Donald Trump called Google CEO Sundar Pichai a “monster” while addressing reporters at a White House meeting on frontier AI. Pichai responded with a joke, saying he hoped it would be a “better tagline” than being called a monster.

item.title: From newsroom to throne: Who is Edward Rukidi Kijanangoma? Former TV anchor crowned king in Uganda
item.description: Kijanangoma worked as a broadcaster in a career spanning more than two decades, including in neighbouring Rwanda, with the Uganda Broadcasting Corporation (UBC), BBC said.

item.title: US-Iran war news LIVE Updates: JPMorgan says Middle East crude oil flows touch 98% of pre-war level
item.description: US-Iran war news LIVE Updates: Crude oil flows from the Middle East are almost back to pre-war levels despite continued risks to shipping, according to JPMorgan Chase & Co.

item.title: Petrol, diesel prices today, September 30: Check fuel cost in Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru
item.description: In Mumbai, the retail price of petrol stood at ₹111.21 per litre, remaining unchanged from the previous day.

item.title: Pentagon awards Boeing $20 bn contract for US Navy's next-generation fighter jet: How the competition was decided
item.description: The Pentagon awarded Boeing a $20 billion contract to develop and build the US Navy's next-generation fighter jets, officials announced Tuesday (local time).

item.title: Govt may hike outlay under two key tax refund schemes for exporters to ₹2 trillion over five years
item.description: India plans to increase tax refunds to exporters to nearly ₹2 trillion over five years through RoDTEP and RoSCTL programmes, aimed at easing liquidity amidst global challenges and boosting competitiveness as export demands rise post-conflict.

item.title: Now, Centre tasks secretaries to hold Chintan Shivir to brainstorm reforms, improve welfare scheme delivery
item.description: The Union government has directed ministry secretaries to conduct Chintan Shivir (brainstorming) sessions in early October to translate high-level ministerial goals into ground-level reforms.&nbsp;

item.title: University of Georgia student survives eight-storey fall after reportedly dancing on couch near open window
item.description: University of Georgia student Kristin Sargent survived an eight-storey fall from her Athens apartment after reportedly falling through an open window while dancing. She remains seriously injured but is expected to recover, police said.

item.title: Russian president Putin’s secret nuclear command bunker amid tensions with West: Report
item.description: The site is associated with Russia’s Perimeter nuclear command system, known in the West as “Dead Hand”.

item.title: UK Police Find Fuel But No Explosives at Fairford Scene
item.description: UK counter-terror police investigating an incident at an airbase used by the US to launch strikes in Iran said they found fuel but no explosives at the scene.

item.title: Kathua shooting: CISF Head Constable kills 4 colleagues in Jammu and Kashmir
item.description: The incident reportedly occurred around 7 pm at the Sewa Project in Mashka village, located in the Basohli area of Kathua district.

item.title: Inflation isn't done: Interest rates likely to rise more, Fed Governor Michael Barr warns
item.description: Federal Reserve Governor Michael Barr warned that interest rates may rise further to combat inflation, which is still significantly above the 2% target. Despite strong economic performance, officials anticipate one more rate hike this year as they focus on achieving price stability.

item.title: India’s ageing population set to reshape economy as fertility falls below replacement: Moody’s
item.description: Although India’s population remains relatively young, the country’s fertility rate has fallen below replacement and its age structure is beginning to change, setting the stage for a much older population in the coming decades, Moody’s said

item.title: US tightens H-1B rules again: How new fees and layoff scrutiny could affect Indian tech workers
item.description: The US has tightened H-1B rules with a $100,000 payment for certain new overseas hires, additional employer fees, layoff scrutiny and tougher enforcement, creating new hurdles for Indian technology workers and their employers.

item.title: WorldSkills Shanghai: Smriti Nambiar bags silver, Best of Nation award
item.description: India won six silver medals at WorldSkills Shanghai 2026, with baker Smriti Nambiar also earning the Best of Nation award. Here's who the winners are, what they achieved and why India's performance marks a milestone for its skilled youth.

item.title: America.gov launch: What Americans can do on Trump’s new AI-powered government website
item.description: The platform, launched in its first phase on September 29, allows users to ask questions in natural language and receive answers based on information published on official US government websites. Responses also include links to the original government sources.

item.title: 'Gutkha Free’ Uber driver badge? Mumbai man’s post on civic sense sparks online debate
item.description: Calling the behaviour ‘quite disgusting and just vile’, Sidhant Bakshi said he had asked drivers not to spit during rides but often received dismissive or puzzled reactions.

item.title: CAQM modifies GRAP rules: Here’s what you need to know about new Delhi-NCR restrictions
item.description: CAQM has modified GRAP rules for Delhi-NCR, extending curbs on older vehicles to Sonipat and moving some bus restrictions to GRAP-1. Exemptions for certain goods vehicles have also been removed, while construction norms have been expanded.

item.title: US employment data August: Job openings fall, layoffs decline as labour market holds steady
item.description: Job openings, a measure of labour demand, fell by 256,000 to 7.079 million on the last day of August, the US Labor Department’s Bureau of Labor Statistics said in its Job Openings and Labor Turnover Survey (JOLTS) report on Tuesday.

item.title: Cat and rat droppings, flies, dead cockroaches: Why Mumbai’s century-old Kyani & Co faces FDA action
item.description: The Maharashtra FDA has suspended licences or ordered action against 13 Mumbai food establishments after inspections found serious hygiene lapses, including pest infestations, unsafe food storage and faulty refrigeration.

item.title: Have any traffic challan still unpaid? The amount may be added to your electricity bill
item.description: The Supreme Court has proposed adding unpaid traffic fines to electricity bills to improve recovery. With ₹20,000 crore in fines unpaid, the court emphasised the need for more effective measures than issuing e-challans.

item.title: India sets 2026-27 foodgrain target below last year’s record output
item.description: For the 2026-27 crop year, India targets 373.93 million tonnes of foodgrain production amid concerns over weather impacts. Key crops like rice and maize show a decline

item.title: US elections under threat? Pentagon ramps up cyber fight against foreign interference — report
item.description: The directive reportedly comes as the threat of foreign interference has remained a recurring concern during US election cycles over the past many years

item.title: Delhi to restrict older vehicles registered outside city from Nov 1 | Should you worry?
item.description: BS-VI-compliant vehicles meet stricter emission standards, contributing to efforts to curb pollution. Vehicles running on CNG, LNG or electricity will be exempted from the rule.

item.title: H-1B visas may look ‘very different’ in a year: What it could mean for Indians in US
item.description: US Labor Department Inspector General Anthony D’Esposito says the H-1B-linked foreign-labour system could change significantly within a year as investigators pursue alleged fraud, exploitation and potential human trafficking.

item.title: Iran rial crashes past 2.5 million per dollar: War, sanctions push currency to new low
item.description: Iran’s economy was already under sustained pressure from years of international sanctions. The situation has worsened with new US sanctions and a naval blockade targeting Iranian oil exports, which has restricted Tehran’s access to crucial foreign-currency revenues.

item.title: Fake Mounjaro to unapproved retatrutide: Inside India's booming weight-loss drug black market
item.description: Fake Mounjaro, unapproved retatrutide and cheap weight-loss injections are entering India’s booming obesity drug market.

item.title: Tukaram Mundhe on mission again: 'Mother's Milk Is Best' warning mandatory on infant food
item.description: The food safety commissioner said the FDA conducted surveys across Maharashtra and found that packaged food products were not complying with mandatory requirements.

item.title: UPI not working abroad: Indian traveller shares frustration over GPay not functioning in Singapore; netizens react
item.description: Users express frustrations with Indian payment cards abroad, citing issues with Apple Pay and UPI transaction failures, especially in Sri Lanka and Singapore.&nbsp;

item.title: Trump's Iraq withdrawal comes amid war with Iran: 5 things that could change after September 30
item.description: For Iraq, the immediate challenge after September 30 will be to maintain security while asserting sovereignty and managing competing relationships with Washington, Tehran and powerful domestic armed groups.

item.title: Taiwan’s US arms pipeline is slowing: What we know so far about F-16 fighter jets, $14 billion deal and T-Dome
item.description: US ambassador to China told Fox News on Sunday, ‘President Trump continues to say, hey, we sell arms to other people around the world. He actually asked President Xi, would he like to buy some at one point.’

item.title: Trial services index shows 10 of 19 sub-sectors post double-digit growth in July
item.description: India on Tuesday unveiled the fourth trial Index of Services Production (ISP), which marks a significant overhaul of the country’s economic statistics and provides policymakers with a long-awaited monthly measure of activity in the services sector that accounts for more than half of the economy.
